description: Election Commission - The Registration of Electors Act No. 44 of 1980
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the commencement of the revision of electoral registers for 2021 under the Registration of Electors Act. It specifies where copies of electoral registers will be exhibited for public verification and describes the process for updating voter registration details. The content directly relates to electoral processes and voter registration matters, falling clearly under the Elections category (Type 7) as it involves the administration and maintenance of electoral rolls.
